f.title: Obtain personal information lawfully, keep it secure and do not collect, use, transfer or disclose it illegally
f.statement: The personal information of natural persons is protected by law. Any organisation or individual that needs to obtain another person's personal information shall obtain it in accordance with law and ensure its security, and shall not illegally collect, use, process or transmit it, or illegally buy, sell, provide or disclose it.
f.clause: Book I, Chapter V (Civil rights), Article 111
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Any organisation (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider) obtaining personal information
rows.quote: 第一百一十一条 　自然人的个人信息受法律保护。任何组织或者个人需要获取他人个人信息的，应当依法取得并确保信息安全，不得非法收集、使用、加工、传输他人个人信息，不得非法买卖、提供或者公开他人个人信息。
rows.location: Book I, Chapter V (Civil rights), Article 111
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 / 不得 = shall / shall not, level Mandatory. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 111 The personal information of natural persons is protected by law. Any organisation or individual that needs to obtain the personal information of others shall obtain it in accordance with law and ensure the security of the information, and shall not illegally collect, use, process or transmit the personal information of others, or illegally buy, sell, provide or disclose the personal information of others.

f.title: Clinical trials: obtain approval and ethics review, inform subjects of purpose and risks, and get written consent
f.statement: Where clinical trials are needed to develop new drugs or medical devices or new preventive or therapeutic methods, they shall be approved by the relevant competent authority in accordance with law and reviewed and approved by an ethics committee, and the subjects or their guardians shall be informed in detail of the purpose and uses of the trial and the risks that may arise, and their written consent obtained.
f.clause: Book IV, Chapter II (Rights to life, body and health), Article 1008
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules. Clinical trials of new drugs, medical devices and new preventive or therapeutic methods.

rows.quote: 第一千零八条 　为研制新药、医疗器械或者发展新的预防和治疗方法，需要进行临床试验的，应当依法经相关主管部门批准并经伦理委员会审查同意，向受试者或者受试者的监护人告知试验目的、用途和可能产生的风险等详细情况，并经其书面同意。
rows.location: Book IV, Chapter II (Rights to life, body and health), Article 1008
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory; personality-rights provision kept because it governs subject information on risks and written consent in drug trials (the basis for consent covering trial safety data). Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 1008 Where clinical trials are needed to develop new drugs or medical devices or to develop new preventive and therapeutic methods, they shall be approved by the relevant competent authority and reviewed and approved by an ethics committee in accordance with law, and the trial subjects or their guardians shall be informed of details such as the purpose and uses of the trial and the risks that may arise, and their written consent shall be obtained.

f.title: Do not infringe privacy by prying, intrusion, leaking or disclosure
f.statement: Natural persons enjoy the right to privacy. No organisation or individual may infringe another person's right to privacy by prying, intrusion, leaking, disclosure or similar means. Privacy is a natural person's undisturbed private life and the private space, private activities and private information that the person does not want others to know.
f.clause: Book IV, Chapter VI (Privacy and personal information protection), Article 1032
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules.

rows.actor: Any organisation (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider)
rows.quote:
第一千零三十二条 　自然人享有隐私权。任何组织或者个人不得以刺探、侵扰、泄露、公开等方式侵害他人的隐私权。 

 　　隐私是自然人的私人生活安宁和不愿为他人知晓的私密空间、私密活动、私密信息。
rows.location: Book IV, Chapter VI (Privacy and personal information protection), Article 1032
rows.review_note: Review: 不得 = shall not, level Mandatory; the definition of privacy kept because it sets the scope of the prohibition. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 1032 Natural persons enjoy the right to privacy. No organisation or individual may infringe the privacy rights of others by prying, intrusion, leaking, disclosure or other means. Privacy is the tranquillity of a natural person's private life and the private space, private activities and private information that the person does not wish others to know.

f.title: Do not process private information without legal basis or the explicit consent of the person
f.statement: Except as otherwise provided by law or with the explicit consent of the right-holder, no organisation or individual may process another person's private information (or infringe privacy in the other ways listed in Article 1033, such as harassing by phone, messages or e-mail, or intruding into private spaces or activities).
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules. Private information (私密信息) within case data, e.g. sensitive health details.
f.exceptions: Where the law provides otherwise or the right-holder has explicitly consented.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Any organisation (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider)
rows.quote:
第一千零三十三条 　除法律另有规定或者权利人明确同意外，任何组织或者个人不得实施下列行为： 

 　　（一）以电话、短信、即时通讯工具、电子邮件、传单等方式侵扰他人的私人生活安宁； 

 　　（二）进入、拍摄、窥视他人的住宅、宾馆房间等私密空间； 

 　　（三）拍摄、窥视、窃听、公开他人的私密活动； 

 　　（四）拍摄、窥视他人身体的私密部位； 

 　　（五）处理他人的私密信息； 

 　　（六）以其他方式侵害他人的隐私权。
rows.review_note: Review: 不得 = shall not, level Mandatory. Item (5) (processing private information) is the PV-relevant item; the full article is quoted so the exception (law or explicit consent) stays with it. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 1033 Except as otherwise provided by law or with the explicit consent of the right-holder, no organisation or individual may carry out the following acts: (1) disturbing the tranquillity of another person's private life by telephone, text message, instant messaging tools, e-mail, leaflets or other means; (2) entering, photographing or peeping into another person's private space such as a residence or hotel room; (3) photographing, peeping at, eavesdropping on or disclosing another person's private activities; (4) photographing or peeping at private parts of another person's body; (5) processing another person's private information; (6) infringing another person's privacy rights by other means.

f.title: Treat health information as protected personal information (scope of the duties)
f.statement: The personal information of natural persons is protected by law. Personal information is any information recorded electronically or otherwise that, alone or combined with other information, identifies a specific natural person, including name, date of birth, ID number, biometric information, address, telephone number, e-mail address, health information and whereabouts. Private information within personal information is governed by the privacy rules, and otherwise by the personal information rules. The duties in Articles 1035 to 1038 therefore apply to identifiable health information in safety reports.
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Any organisation processing personal information (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider)
rows.quote:
第一千零三十四条 　自然人的个人信息受法律保护。 

 　　个人信息是以电子或者其他方式记录的能够单独或者与其他信息结合识别特定自然人的各种信息，包括自然人的姓名、出生日期、身份证件号码、生物识别信息、住址、电话号码、电子邮箱、健康信息、行踪信息等。 

 　　个人信息中的私密信息，适用有关隐私权的规定；没有规定的，适用有关个人信息保护的规定。
rows.review_note: Review: binding definition kept because it sets the scope of the processing duties (health information named). Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: definition only, no modal verb; held below 90 per the definitions rule. The last sentence of the statement is a scope note linking to Arts. 1035-1038.
rows.quote_en: Article 1034 The personal information of natural persons is protected by law. Personal information is all kinds of information recorded electronically or by other means that can, alone or combined with other information, identify a specific natural person, including the natural person's name, date of birth, identity document number, biometric information, address, telephone number, e-mail address, health information, whereabouts information, etc. Private information within personal information is governed by the provisions on the right to privacy; where there are none, the provisions on personal information protection apply.

f.title: Process personal information lawfully, legitimately and only as necessary, with consent, published rules and stated purpose
f.statement: Processing of personal information (collection, storage, use, processing, transmission, provision, disclosure, etc.) shall follow the principles of lawfulness, legitimacy and necessity, shall not be excessive, and shall meet these conditions: (1) the consent of the natural person or their guardian is obtained, unless laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise; (2) the rules for processing are made public; (3) the purpose, method and scope of processing are expressly stated; (4) the processing does not violate laws, administrative regulations or the parties' agreement.
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules.
f.exceptions: Consent is not needed where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise (e.g. statutory adverse reaction reporting).
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Personal information processor (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider)
rows.quote:
第一千零三十五条 　处理个人信息的，应当遵循合法、正当、必要原则，不得过度处理，并符合下列条件： 

 　　（一）征得该自然人或者其监护人同意，但是法律、行政法规另有规定的除外； 

 　　（二）公开处理信息的规则； 

 　　（三）明示处理信息的目的、方式和范围； 

 　　（四）不违反法律、行政法规的规定和双方的约定。 

 　　个人信息的处理包括个人信息的收集、存储、使用、加工、传输、提供、公开等。
data_elements: purpose, method and scope of processing
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 / 不得 = shall / shall not, level Mandatory; the consent exception (laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise) kept, which covers statutory ADR reporting. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 1035 The processing of personal information shall follow the principles of lawfulness, legitimacy and necessity, shall not be excessive, and shall meet the following conditions: (1) the consent of the natural person or their guardian is obtained, except where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise; (2) the rules for processing the information are made public; (3) the purpose, method and scope of the processing are expressly stated; (4) it does not violate laws, administrative regulations or the agreement of the parties. Processing of personal information includes the collection, storage, use, processing, transmission, provision and disclosure of personal information, etc.

f.title: No civil liability for processing within consent, of lawfully public information, or reasonably in the public interest
f.statement: A processor of personal information bears no civil liability where it: (1) acts reasonably within the scope of the consent of the natural person or their guardian; (2) reasonably processes information the person has made public or that has otherwise been lawfully made public, unless the person explicitly refuses or the processing harms their major interests; (3) acts reasonably in other ways to protect the public interest or the person's lawful rights and interests.
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). Curated only for the personality-rights and personal-information provisions that bind a company (MAH, sponsor, PV service provider) processing PV/safety data; health information is personal information (Art. 1034). The Personal Information Protection Law sets the detailed rules. E.g. literature-sourced cases (lawfully public information) and safety processing in the public interest.
f.exceptions: For public information: not where the person explicitly refuses or the processing harms their major interests.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Personal information processor (e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider)
rows.quote:
第一千零三十六条 　处理个人信息，有下列情形之一的，行为人不承担民事责任： 

 　　（一）在该自然人或者其监护人同意的范围内合理实施的行为； 

 　　（二）合理处理该自然人自行公开的或者其他已经合法公开的信息，但是该自然人明确拒绝或者处理该信息侵害其重大利益的除外； 

 　　（三）为维护公共利益或者该自然人合法权益，合理实施的其他行为。
rows.review_note: Review: liability exemption, level Permitted. Relevant to processing published literature cases and safety processing in the public interest. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: held below 90 because the article states a liability safe harbour, not a duty or express permission.
rows.quote_en: Article 1036 In processing personal information, the actor bears no civil liability in any of the following circumstances: (1) acts reasonably carried out within the scope of consent of the natural person or their guardian; (2) reasonable processing of information that the natural person has made public themselves or that has otherwise been lawfully made public, except where the natural person explicitly refuses or the processing of the information infringes their major interests; (3) other acts reasonably carried out to protect the public interest or the lawful rights and interests of the natural person.

f.title: Let individuals consult, copy and correct their personal information
f.statement: A natural person may, in accordance with law, consult or copy their personal information held by an information processor; on finding errors, they have the right to object and to request that necessary measures such as correction be taken in a timely manner. The processor must be able to act on these requests.
f.topic: Data subject rights: access and correction
f.clause: Book IV, Chapter VI, Article 1037, paragraph 1
f.applicability: China; 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code of the PRC, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021). rows.quote: 第一千零三十七条 　自然人可以依法向信息处理者查阅或者复制其个人信息；发现信息有错误的，有权提出异议并请求及时采取更正等必要措施。

rows.quote_en: Article 1037 A natural person may, in accordance with law, consult or copy their personal information from an information processor; on finding that the information is erroneous, they have the right to raise an objection and request that necessary measures such as correction be taken in a timely manner.

f.title: Delete personal information processed in breach of law or agreement on request
f.statement: Where a natural person finds that an information processor has processed their personal information in violation of laws, administrative regulations or the parties' agreement, they have the right to request the processor to delete it in a timely manner.
f.clause: Book IV, Chapter VI, Article 1037, paragraph 2

f.title: Do not leak or tamper with personal information or provide it to others without consent unless irreversibly de-identified
f.statement: An information processor shall not leak or tamper with personal information it has collected or stored, and shall not illegally provide a natural person's personal information to others without their consent, except where the information has been processed so that a specific person cannot be identified and it cannot be restored.
f.clause: Book IV, Chapter VI, Article 1038, paragraph 1

f.exceptions: Information processed so that no specific person can be identified and that cannot be restored.

f.title: Take technical and other necessary measures to keep collected and stored personal information secure
f.statement: An information processor shall take technical measures and other necessary measures to ensure the security of the personal information it collects and stores and to prevent its leakage, tampering or loss.

f.title: On a personal information leak, tampering or loss: remedy promptly, inform the persons and report to the authorities
f.statement: Where leakage, tampering or loss of personal information occurs or may occur, the information processor shall take remedial measures in a timely manner, inform the natural persons concerned in accordance with the regulations and report to the relevant competent authorities.
